definitions.gloss: cheering squad; pep squad; cheerleading team
definitions.explanation: An organized group that leads cheers and encourages athletes or competitors, especially at school sporting events. In Japan, traditional {応援団|おうえんだん} are known for their military-style discipline and coordinated chants.

definitions.gloss: support group; group of supporters; fan base
definitions.explanation: More broadly, any group of people who actively support a person, team, cause, or organization.

examples.japanese: {応援団|おうえんだん}が{声|こえ}を{張|は}り{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: The cheering squad raised their voices.

examples.japanese: {高校|こうこう}{時代|じだい}は{応援団|おうえんだん}に{入|はい}っていた。
examples.english: I was in the cheering squad in high school.

examples.japanese: {甲子園|こうしえん}では{各校|かっこう}の{応援団|おうえんだん}が{熱|あつ}い{声援|せいえん}を{送|おく}る。
examples.english: At Koshien, each school's cheering squad sends passionate cheers.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}には{強力|きょうりょく}な{応援団|おうえんだん}がいる。
examples.english: He has a strong group of supporters behind him.

examples.japanese: {地元|じもと}の{応援団|おうえんだん}がスタジアムを{埋|う}め{尽|つ}くした。
examples.english: The local supporters filled the stadium.

examples.japanese: {選挙|せんきょ}{活動|かつどう}を{支|ささ}える{応援団|おうえんだん}を{結成|けっせい}した。
examples.english: They formed a support group to back the election campaign.

notes:
Composed of {応援|おうえん} (support/cheering) + {団|だん} (group/team). Japanese school {応援団|おうえんだん} are distinctive: they typically feature a {団長|だんちょう} (squad leader) in a traditional long coat who leads synchronized chants and gestures, quite different from Western cheerleading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {応援団|おうえんだん}{長|ちょう}: cheering squad leader
- {応援団|おうえんだん}に{入|はい}る: to join the cheering squad
- {応援団|おうえんだん}を{結成|けっせい}する: to form a support group

CULTURAL NOTE:
Traditional school {応援団|おうえんだん} are known for strict hierarchical discipline, loud rhythmic cheering, and distinctive uniforms (often a long black coat called {学ラン|がくらん}). They are a staple of Japanese school culture and appear frequently in manga and anime.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- チアリーダー: cheerleader — Western-style cheerleading, now also common in Japan
- サポーター: supporter — mainly used for sports fan groups
- {応援|おうえん}する: to cheer; to support — the verb form
